categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, design, production and sales of injection molded products and precision injection molds. It is an integrated 'mold-injection' manufacturing enterprise offering industrial design, precision mold design and manufacturing, injection molding, spraying, and assembly services. Main products are widely applied in consumer electronics, toys and daily goods, automotive parts, and medical devices sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced capabilities in precision injection molding, high-molecular material preparation and application, automated assembly, and high-precision mold design and development. Mold cavity processing precision reaches ±0.001mm with service life of 1.5 million mold cycles. The company employs rapid prototyping technology, high-speed machining, and ultra-precision machining techniques. Production follows 'sales-driven production' model with strict quality control systems including ISO9001, ISO14001, and IATF16949 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are concentrated in four sectors: consumer electronics, toys and daily goods, automotive parts, and medical devices. Major customers include Logitech Group (primary customer for mouse shells), Hikvision, Preh Gleichmann, Minth Group, and Aikon Biotech. The company serves as an important supplier to well-known domestic and international manufacturers with long-term stable partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province. It has established production facilities in Hefei, Anhui Province, and Vietnam. International sales are primarily to North America and Southeast Asia, representing 25.87% of total revenue. The company has subsidiaries including Lian Vietnam Technology Company Limited and Anbigen (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures precision injection molds and injection molded products for downstream customers in consumer electronics, automotive, medical devices, and toys industries. The company sources raw materials (plastic pellets, mold steel, universal components) from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products directly to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) intelligent manufacturing and automation through dual-arm collaborative robot research; (2) advanced material development including PC/ABS alloys, TPE materials, and ceramic-coated elastomers; (3) PCR recycled plastic applications; (4) deep collaboration with Zhejiang University on AI recognition and 3D modeling technologies; (5) regional expansion through Vietnam facility optimization; (6) new market development to reduce customer concentration risk.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through direct sales of injection molded products and precision injection molds. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer confirmation. Mold development and manufacturing are separately contracted and invoiced. The company also provides mold maintenance and technical improvement services. Revenue model is primarily product sales-based with long-term customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a high-end precision manufacturer in the injection molding industry. It holds status as a national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise and Ningbo manufacturing single-champion cultivation enterprise. The industry shows significant polarization with the company competing through superior technical capabilities, quality standards, and customer relationships rather than price competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2024 revenue reached 511.8 million yuan (up 9.01% YoY), with net profit attributable to parent company of 65.8 million yuan (down 13.07% YoY). Total assets grew 51.87% to 997.7 million yuan, while shareholders' equity increased 96.09% to 782.7 million yuan. The company completed IPO in June 2024, raising 331.5 million yuan net proceeds. Asset-liability ratio improved to 21.55% from 39.23%, indicating strengthened financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) superior precision capabilities (±0.001mm mold cavity accuracy, 1.5 million cycle mold life); (2) comprehensive integrated services combining design, mold manufacturing, injection molding, and assembly; (3) strong R&D capabilities with 88 R&D personnel and continuous innovation in materials and processes; (4) established relationships with leading global brands providing quality assurance and technical reliability; (5) commitment to sustainable practices including PCR recycled plastic applications and environmental certifications.
